entries.definition: showing sustained enthusiastic action with unflagging vitality
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Formal and the most admiring of the three, treating the unflagging vitality as a quality of character rather than a rate of output.
examples: an indefatigable advocate of equal rights

entries.definition: quick and energetic
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Warmer than *brisk*, since the quickness comes with visible animation rather than a merely good rate.

entries.definition: quick and energetic
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Makes speed sound light and unforced where *brisk* makes it sound efficient.

entries.definition: characterized by energetic bodily activity
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Puts the energy in the body and stops there - a description of what the activity is, not a verdict on it as *lively* is.

entries.definition: quick and energetic
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: An intensifier more than a description, pushing quickness toward headlong in a way *brisk* never does.

entries.definition: quick and energetic
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Informal and clipped - quickness with an edge on it, sharper and less dignified than *brisk*.

entries.definition: quick and energetic
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Showier than *brisk*, admiring the sheer unchecked vigor of the pace rather than its neatness.

entries.definition: showing sustained enthusiastic action with unflagging vitality
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Plainer than *indefatigable*, praising the sustained action itself without dressing it up.

entries.definition: showing sustained enthusiastic action with unflagging vitality
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praises what does not happen - the enthusiasm never dips - so it commends steadiness where *tireless* commends capacity.

entries.definition: quick and energetic
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The most informal of these, light and almost playful, carrying none of the weight *driving* does.

entries.definition: having unsymmetrical parts or unequal dimensions or measurements
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Technical and cool: it states that parts are out of symmetry or dimensions come out unequal, and stops there without calling either a defect.

entries.definition: (of a contest or contestants) not fairly matched as opponents
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Of a contest or the contestants in it, this puts the fault in the pairing itself - these two should never have been set against each other.

entries.definition: not equal or interchangeable in value, quantity, or significance
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: A flat denial rather than a complaint - the two are not equal and not interchangeable in value, quantity or significance, and the gap between them goes unjudged.

entries.definition: having a better than even chance of success
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The one member where the imbalance is good news: the chance of success runs better than even, so the tilt reads as advantage rather than defect.

entries.definition: debits and credits are not equal
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Strictly the ledger sense - debits failing to answer credits - which lands as an error in the books rather than as a neutral difference.

entries.definition: poorly balanced or matched in quantity or value or measure
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Carries a fault inside the measurement - poorly balanced or matched, not merely different - where *nonequivalent* only records that the quantities fail to agree.

entries.definition: not caused to be equal
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The British spelling of *unequalized* and just as unjudging - it says only that nothing was made equal.

entries.definition: not caused to be equal
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Points at what was not done rather than at the result: no levelling has been applied, where *unequal* passes judgement on the gap that remains.

entries.definition: (of a contest or contestants) not fairly matched as opponents
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Softer than *mismatched* for the same unfair contest: it notes that the thing tilts one way without condemning the making of the match.
examples: vaudeville … waged an uneven battle against the church

entries.definition: having unsymmetrical parts or unequal dimensions or measurements
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The plain-spoken counterpart to *anisometric* for the same condition of parts or measurements, describing the lack of match rather than complaining of it.

entries.definition: implied though not directly expressed; inherent in the nature of something
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Neutral and two-sided, covering both the meaning that was never spelled out and the one that sits in a thing's nature, where *unspoken* reaches only the first.
examples: an implicit agreement not to raise the subject
there was implicit criticism in his voice
anger was implicit in the argument
the oak is implicit in the acorn

entries.definition: in the nature of something though not readily apparent
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: A relational phrase rather than a quality — it must name the thing the sense is lodged in, which the bare adjectives beside it need not do.

entries.definition: implied though not directly expressed; inherent in the nature of something
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Built as a negation, it frames the same implicitness as a shortfall in the telling, where *implicit* frames it as a property of the thing.

entries.definition: in the nature of something though not readily apparent
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The firmest claim of the three: not hidden by accident but built into what the thing is, and so not detachable from it.

entries.definition: implied by or inferred from actions or statements
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The plain everyday word for a meaning that rides along with an act or a statement without being spoken, lighter in weight than *tacit*.

entries.definition: implied by or inferred from actions or statements
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Formal, and it treats the unspoken meaning as settled and binding — something one is held to, which *silent* does not insist on.

entries.definition: in the nature of something though not readily apparent
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Puts the sense beneath a surface rather than inside a nature, implying something could be uncovered, where *inherent* makes it permanent.

entries.definition: implied by or inferred from actions or statements
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Adds successful uptake: the meaning was not merely implied but taken up on both sides, where *tacit* says only that it went unsaid.
examples: the understood provisos of a custody agreement

entries.definition: not made explicit
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Neutral and general — it says the thing found no outward form at all, without insisting that words in particular were what went missing.
examples: the unexpressed terms of the agreement

entries.definition: not made explicit
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The plainest of the negatives, and it carries a faint sense of something held back, where *unexpressed* is a flat report.

entries.definition: not made explicit
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The most loaded of the plain negatives — what is unspoken feels present and deliberately left alone, where *unstated* is only a blank.

entries.definition: not made explicit
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Dry and procedural, marking the absence the way one notes a missing entry, beside the more human *unsaid*.
examples: his action is clear but his reason remains unstated

entries.definition: not made explicit
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Elevated and faintly literary, shaping the omission as something never let out rather than merely never recorded.

entries.definition: not made explicit
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The British spelling of the same clinical term, identical in force to *unverbalized*.

entries.definition: not made explicit
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Clinical in register, framing the gap as a failure to convert into words rather than a silence with any weight to it.

entries.definition: not made explicit
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Implies a voice was available and went unused, which gives it more pull than the flat *unverbalized*.

entries.definition: not elegant or graceful in expression
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Mild - the expression stumbles without collapsing, and no verdict is passed on the ability behind it, unlike *inept*.

entries.definition: not elegant or graceful in expression
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Heavier than *awkward* - the expression is not merely ungainly but handled with a thick hand.

entries.definition: not elegant or graceful in expression
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Faults the expression for weight and unwieldiness, landing on the shape of the thing where *clumsy* lands on the handling.

entries.definition: not elegant or graceful in expression
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Blames the selection rather than the person, faulting the words picked where *inept* faults whoever picked them.

entries.definition: not elegant or graceful in expression
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The dry, measured option - it records an expression as not fitting, with none of *clumsy*'s picture of bungled handling.

entries.definition: not elegant or graceful in expression
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The hardest of these words - it shifts the fault from the phrasing to the ability behind it, so gracelessness reads as incompetence.
examples: if the rumor is true, can anything be more inept than to repeat it now?

entries.definition: not appropriate in application; defective
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Formal and softened - it marks a thing as both misapplied and defective while keeping an apologetic surface, where *inept* simply condemns.
examples: the infelicitous typesetting was due to illegible copy

entries.definition: unsuitable or regrettable
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The gentlest wording available - it calls a thing unsuitable and regrettable at once, treating the fault as bad luck rather than bad work.

entries.definition: most unfortunate or miserable
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Superlative and unsparing, pushing misfortune to its floor where *unfortunate* only notes that luck ran out.
examples: the most abject slaves joined in the revolt

entries.definition: (of events) having extremely unfortunate or dire consequences; bringing ruin
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Delivers the verdict in one flat syllable, calling an event doomed where *calamitous* spells out the wreckage.
examples: the stock market crashed on Black Friday

entries.definition: (of events) having extremely unfortunate or dire consequences; bringing ruin
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Sizes the event by the wreckage it brings and says so at volume, where *black* passes the same sentence without raising its voice.

entries.definition: (of events) having extremely unfortunate or dire consequences; bringing ruin
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The plainest word for ruin at full scale, doing the work of *calamitous* without its air of grandeur.
examples: the battle was a disastrous end to a disastrous campaign
